rows.status: Substituted by HB10447

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE THE EXPLORATION, DEVELOPMENT AND PRODUCTION OF GEOTHERMAL RESOURCES
rows.abstract: "Geothermal Resources Act of 1995" Seeks to develop geothermal energy, one of the country's available indigenous, renewable and most practical base loan energy sources. Is based on the result of studies that geothermal power is the cheapest, safest,most reliable and more environment-fri endly compared to oil and coal alternatives because it has virtually no fuel cost in its oepration while its pricing is not affected by severe oil fluctuations.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN THE NATIONAL PROGRAM FOR THE DEVELOPMENT AND PROMOTION OF THE USE OF NON-CONVENTIONA L ENERGY SYSTEMS
rows.abstract: "National Non-Conventiona l Energy Program Act" Strengthens and institutionaliz es the government efforts to implement a decentralized, area-based and integrated national energy program for the promotion and commercializati on of the use of non-conventiona l energy systems. Enumerates the inexhaustible energy resources for development as biomass, solar, wind, micro-hydro and ocean energy.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE NATIONAL ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION (NEA) AND THE RURAL ELECTRIC COOPERATIVES (RECS) BY RELEIVING THEM OF CERTAIN LOAN OBLIGATIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to institutionaliz e the recommendation of the Department of Finance through its Government Corporate Monitoring and Coordinating Commitee to revitalize the National Electrification Administration and the Rural Electric Cooepratives (RECs) contained in the Bail Out Plan which includes the write-off of receivables of electric cooperatives amounting to almost P4.39 Million consisting of accounts from the cooperatives, Pielstick loans, loans to the RECs and social projects not related to rural electrification .
rows.status: Substituted by HB02355

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE EXPLORATION, DISCOVERY AND PRODUCTION OF INDIGENOUS OIL AND GAS
rows.abstract: "Oil and Gas Act of 1995" Seeks to institutionaliz e improved fiscal incenties and provides for a mechanism for the development of local expertise in the oil exploration, development and production. Aims to (1) strengthen the control and supervisionof the State over petroleum operations; (2) establish a framework for natural gas development; (3) provide new and clear incentives for the development of the private Filipino-owned petroleum exploration companies to encourage a more active participation; (4) provide new incentives to foreign petroleum exploration companies, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INSTITUTIONALIZ E ENERGY CONSERVATION AND ENHANCE EFFICIENT USE OF ENERGY
rows.abstract: "Energy Conservation Act of 1995" Declares it a policy of the State to institutionaliz e energy conservation and enhance the efficient utilization of energy in order to ensure availability of energy supplies required to support the socio-economic goals of the country; states the powers and functions of the Dept. of Energy.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE SOURCES AND USES OF THE OIL PRICE STABILIZATION FUND, SETTING ITS MAXIMUM AND MINIMUM LEVELS, AND PROVIDING FOR AN AUTOMATIC PRICE ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM FOR THE PRICE-REGULATED REFINED PETROLEUM PRODUCTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSEPRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED NINETEEN HUNDRED FIFTY-SIX, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to define sources and uses of the Oil Price Stabilization Fund (OPSF); sets its maximum and minimum levels; provides for an automatic price adjustment mechanism for the price-regulated refined petroleum products; mandates the Department of Energy to undertake regular information campaigns on the OPSF mechanism, guidelines, formula, procedures and Fund status, and; seeks to minimize political intervention in oil price adjustment decisions.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05264

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZ ING THE NATIONAL PUBLIC MARKET CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: "National Public Market Code of the Philippines" Institutionaliz es specific guidelines that will develop, regulate and standardize the country's public market system in terms of location, establishment and construction, sanitation, security and safety, service areas/facilitie s set up, awarding and occupancy of stalls, collection and use of market fees, and administration of public markets and its support facilities.
